title: Teams calls down for a whole team — not the open Exchange incident

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

incidents.subject: MAJOR: Exchange Online mail delivery delayed for all users

input.subject: Teams calls failing for the whole sales team

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Since about 10am none of the sales team can join or make Teams calls — it just says 'We couldn't connect the call'. Chat still works. Mail is fine as far as I can tell. We have client calls all afternoon.

Tom

triage.subcategory: Teams calling outage for a team

handling.escalation_reason: A service is down for several people.

rationale: Service down for multiple people: P1, on-call. The only open incident is Exchange mail, a different failure; linking to it on the strength of 'Microsoft 365' would be the vague-similarity guess the triage prompt forbids.
